description: Runs a model from the Model Training step (YOLO or HuggingFace) over a folder of images and writes predictions.json and summary.json.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The trained model: a YOLO .pt file (Model Training's `model` output for YOLO is weights/best.pt) or a HuggingFace model folder (best_model/). Copied into the job before it runs.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Folder of images to run on. Searched recursively for .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .bmp, .tiff and .webp files.

framework.description: Framework the model was trained with. Must match the model input: 'yolo' for a .pt file, 'huggingface' for a saved model folder.

task.description: What the model predicts. Must match the task it was trained for.

conf.description: Minimum confidence (0–1) for a prediction to be kept. Lower it to see more, less certain predictions.

batch.description: HuggingFace only: images per forward pass. Lower it if the GPU runs out of memory.

imgsz.description: YOLO only: inference image size in pixels. Use the size the model was trained at (Model Training's image size, 640 by default).

device.description: Compute device. 'cuda' needs a GPU node; the job falls back to CPU if none is visible.

tapis_job.name: hf-inference
tapis_job.description: YOLO / HuggingFace inference over an image directory

fileInputs.name: model
fileInputs.description: Ultralytics picks the loader from the file extension, so a YOLO model must keep its .pt name.

fileInputs.name: model
fileInputs.description: A HuggingFace model is a folder (config, weights, image processor).

appArgs.name: output
appArgs.description: infer_main.py writes to <output_path>/<name>/, so this lands in /job/output: the job's output dir, which Tapis archives to the run folder.
